title: The Divine Smile
author: Majrooh Rashid
text:
The sunshine 
of the divine smile,
blossoming
on the petals,
of the ebony brown rose,
at this hour of dusk,
took
the frozen black night 
within,
by a pleasant surprise.
At first
I thought it was a vision, 
the next moment I felt it all.
The ice melted away,

the flow of waters of life 
into the eternal ocean 
of primeval dream
that Adam and Eve saw 
at  first sight.
stanzas: I thought it was a vision,
the next moment I felt it all.
the flow of waters of life
